description: Main React component for a multi-step checkout process, managing state, validation, and rendering subcomponents for cart, address, payment, and confirmation steps.

methods.name: validateAddress
methods.description: Validates the address form fields, sets error messages, and returns true if valid.

methods.name: validatePayment
methods.description: Validates the payment form fields, sets error messages, and returns true if valid.

methods.name: canProceed
methods.description: Determines if the user can proceed to the next step based on current validation.

methods.name: onNext
methods.description: Handles progressing to the next step or confirming the purchase.

methods.name: onBack
methods.description: Handles navigating back to the previous step.
